_key.description: Variant key, Ensembl protein ID and source file accession joined by underscores.

motif.title: Motif
motif.description: SEMpl motif for the transcription factor.

ref_seq_context.title: Reference Sequence Context
ref_seq_context.description: Coordinate range on the reference genome holding the highest SEM score with the reference allele.

alt_seq_context.title: Alternate Sequence Context
alt_seq_context.description: Coordinate range on the reference genome holding the highest SEM score with the alternate allele. For an indel, apply the change described by the variant identifier to this reference range to recreate the alternate sequence.

ref_score.title: Reference Score
ref_score.description: Predicted binding score at the reference allele: the transcription factor's affinity for the reference sequence, relative to its average binding affinity.

alt_score.title: Alternate Score
alt_score.description: Predicted binding score at the alternate allele, on the same scale as ref_score.

variant_effect_score.title: Variant Effect Score
variant_effect_score.description: log2 ratio of alt_score to ref_score. Positive values mean increased preference for the alternate allele, negative values increased preference for the reference allele.

SEMpl_annotation.title: SEMpl Annotation
SEMpl_annotation.description: Predicted effect of the variant on binding, assigned by comparing reference and alternate scores against 2 raised to SEMpl_baseline.

enum_descriptions.no_binding: Neither allele has a binding score above the binding threshold.
enum_descriptions.binding_unchanged: Binding is retained without a change in the predicted binding classification.
enum_descriptions.binding_increased: The alternate allele has stronger predicted binding.
enum_descriptions.binding_decreased: The alternate allele has weaker predicted binding.
enum_descriptions.binding_created: Only the alternate allele has a binding score above the binding threshold.
enum_descriptions.binding_ablated: Only the reference allele has a binding score above the binding threshold.

SEMpl_baseline.title: SEMpl Baseline
SEMpl_baseline.description: log2 of the average transcription factor binding signal across randomly scrambled endogenous kmers: a baseline where binding is not expected to occur. Binding is called only for scores above 2 raised to this value. Constant across every variant scored with the same SNP Effect Matrix.

biological_process.title: Biological Process
biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for the process this edge represents.
